services.title: Geospatial AI and machine learning
services.short: Deep-learning models that find and count objects in imagery, and predictive models tested on ground they have not seen.

services.title: Drone mapping and photogrammetry
services.short: I plan and fly the survey, then turn the imagery into orthomosaics, surface and terrain models, and counts.

services.title: Satellite remote sensing
services.short: Land cover, vegetation, water and change over time, read from optical and radar satellite imagery, anywhere.

services.title: GIS mapping and spatial analysis
services.short: Site selection, access and proximity analysis, map production and clean, well-structured spatial data.

services.title: Flood, climate and environmental risk
services.short: Where flooding is more likely, which people, roads and facilities sit in the way, and how land cover is changing.

services.title: Web GIS development and dashboards
services.short: Interactive web maps, Streamlit apps and Power BI dashboards that work on any device.

services.title: Spatial databases and data engineering
services.short: PostGIS databases and repeatable Python and Earth Engine pipelines that keep spatial data current.

services.title: Training and capacity building
services.short: Hands-on Python, GIS and remote sensing training for teams, from small workshops to a 1,500-person seminar.

also: Also: cartography and map production for reports, digitising and data cleaning, geocoding, OpenStreetMap mapping, site suitability studies and GNSS ground control. If your question involves a place, ask.
